title: Ciphertext Stehle local-regularity prior
rationale: The registered KryptosBot findings source documents the Stehle local regularity as an unresolved structural anomaly, not as plaintext, key material, a route, or a solution claim. This lane fixes the anomaly surface as a deterministic planning artifact before any future source-backed observation scoring, while preserving the coordinate caveat that the source labels the window 55 through 63 and the repo's canonical one-based K4 text maps the displayed DIAWINFBN sequence to positions 56 through 64. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because it uses a source-documented ciphertext-local rule and excludes public known-plaintext positions from future target scoring.
prediction_target: Future independently source-backed non-anchor K4 position observations may be checked against the predeclared Stehle local-regularity window only after a family-specific evaluator and null controls are implemented; this artifact alone is not evidence.
discovery_inputs: Registered methodology-context source kryptosbot-findings-2026 for the bounded Stehle local-regularity surface
Public K4 ciphertext interpreted through the repo's canonical one-based position convention
Standard A=0 alphabet indexes, lag 4, expected delta +5 modulo 26, and the displayed DIAWINFBN sequence mapped to canonical positions 56 through 64
Fixed non-anchor exclusion mask before any observation scoring
No candidate words, key material, routes, claimed plaintext, additive fragment values, or previous source-backed observation hits
evaluation_inputs: A future family-specific observation validator and evaluator for the committed Stehle regularity artifact
Future independently source-backed non-anchor K4 position observations with source IDs, one-based positions, notes, and rationale declared before scoring
Observation files whose scored positions were not used to construct or tune the Stehle regularity artifact
controls: validate-prediction-artifact gate before any evaluator is implemented or used
family-specific observation validator and evaluator required before scoring
seeded same-size non-anchor position-shuffle null required before interpreting source-backed hit counts
ciphertext-symbol shuffle baseline preserving K4 length and alphabet membership required before interpreting the local regularity itself
known public-anchor positions used only as an exclusion mask, not as scoring evidence or tuning input
multiple-comparison context across all preregistered independent lanes required before interpretation
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat controls without post-hoc retuning
